findings.body: New evidence not covered by the coordinate-materialization ruling is the explicit `neq` skip here. For a monthly single-dimension selection such as `gl in [5001, 5002]` combined with `gl neq 5002`, the repository facts correctly exclude 5002, but `selectionValues` still returns both positive values and `completeMonthlyCoordinates` recreates 5002 for every month. With confirmed coverage those excluded rows can be reported as exact zeroes, violating the requested scope and inventing factual output. Excluded values must be removed from the materialized candidate set.
findings.title: Not done: exact factual answers without guessed scope

findings.body: The selected-GL repository test covers only a positive `in` filter. It remains green when coordinate completion reintroduces a value excluded by a simultaneous `neq` filter. Add a repository-level case combining inclusion and exclusion and assert that the excluded coordinate produces no rows in any requested month.
findings.title: Not done: combined include/exclude monthly-coordinate test
